title: Binary Search
description: Given `N`, a **sorted** ascending array of `N` distinct integers, and a `target`, implement binary search in `O(log N)` time to print its 0-based index, or `-1` if not found.
instructions: Narrow the search range by half on each step.
hints: If `arr[mid] == target`, return `mid`. If `arr[mid] < target`, `low = mid + 1`, else `high = mid - 1`.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
target = int(input().strip())
# Implement binary search
